DOP: atināmeti, ~ayati pr. 3 sg. [ BHS atināmayati, atināmeti], 1. spends (time), lets (time) elapse; lets the time pass ; M II 139, 14 (bhuttāvī muhuttaṃ tuṇhī nisīdati na ca anumodanassa kālaṃ ~eti); A I 206, 3 (so tena lobhena abhijjhāsahagatena cetasā divasaṃ ~eti); IV 227, 20* (ye khaṇaṃ nādhigacchanti ~enti te khaṇaṃ); Mil 345, 5 (nisajjaṭṭhānacaṅkamehi rattindivaṃ ~enti); — 2. makes pass; makes pass into, leads (someone) into ; M II 138, 22 (na ca vyañjanena ālopaṃ ~eti); — aor. 3 sg. atināmayi, Th 366 (bahu-d-eva rattiṃ bhagavā abbhokāse ’tināmayi); 1 sg. ( a ) atināmesiṃ, Ap 251, 5 (ārāmaṃ ~esiṃ lokajeṭṭhaṃ narāsabhaṃ); ( b ) atināmayiṃ, Ap 96, 11 (sambuddhaṃ … ~ayiṃ sagharaṃ, Ee so; Se ~ayi; Ce sakaṃ gharaṃ; Be abhināmayiṃ saṃgharaṃ); — absol. atināmetvā, Ap 254, 12 (sambuddhaṃ … assamaṃ ~etvā); Vibh-a 462, 24 (yathāparicchedena avuṭṭhahitvā kālaṃ ~etvā); — pp atināmita , mfn. , allowed to pass, let elapse ; Mp III 331, 2 (yuttapayuttakālassa ~-ttā); — see also *atineti.
CPD: ati-nāmeti , pr. 3 sg . [ati + √nam, caus. ] , to spend, to pass or let pass ( time ) ; to surpass, omit; 3 sg . AN l 206, 3 (divasaṃ); lll 116, 24 ( do. ); MN ll 139, 14 (anumodanassa kālaṃ, to let the opportunity for anumodana pass; Ps); Th-a ad Th 451 (+ khepeti; = 'vijahate' or 'viharate'); 1 sg . ~emi (rattiṃ), Pj ll 606, 2 (= 'vivasemi'); 3 pl . ~enti, AN lV 227, 20 * (khaṇaṃ, to miss ); Mil 345, 5 (rattindivaṃ); aor. 3 sg . ~nāmayi, Th 366 (rattiṃ abbhokāse); — also of food: to make it pass down, MN ll 138, 22 (na ca vyañjanena ālopaṃ ~eti, i. e. but he does not use the curry in order to make the food ( rice ) slip down; Ps lll 360, 1 ); — esp. to lead somebody into ( with two acc ) : aor. lsg. ~esiṃ (ārāmaṃ . . . lokajeṭṭhaṃ); Ap 251, 5 ; abs. ~etvā (assamam), Ap 254, 12 ; cf. atineti.

— °- kuliya , mfn. , leading to (birth in) a family of low rank ; Ps V 15, 7 (~aṃ kammaṃ); — °- kulīna , nīcā-kulīna, mfn. , born in a family of low rank ; M III 202, 24 (dissanti ~ā dissanti uccākulīnā, Be, Ce so; Ee wr ~-jūtiko); Vism 124, 24 ; As 317, 19 (dīghaṃ … upanidhāya tato ~aṃ rassaṃ); — ~aṃ, adv. , S I 145, 4 (nisīdi … ~aṃ bhagavato, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se °-tarakaṃ); — °- (t)tiṇa , nīcā-tiṇa, mfn. , covered with short grass ; modest conduct ; Ja VI 555, 20´ (apacitiṃ ~iṃ dassentā); Sv 853, 17 (~iyā akaraṇabhāvo); Ps II 99, 29 ; — °- vutti 2 , °- vutti(n) , mfn. , of humble or respectful behaviour, mild; open to advice or instruction;
